DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis / Painful Bladder Syndrome.

The negative urinalysis results rule out a simple urinary tract infection, and your specific symptoms of chronic pelvic pain relieved by voiding, frequency, and dyspareunia despite normal lab work are classic for Interstitial Cystitis.
